title: Mocha and Toasted Cashew Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Cocoa and instant espresso cooked into the custard; toasted cashews folded in; no vanilla.
summary: Our classic custard reworked with cocoa and instant espresso cooked into the base and toasted cashews folded in at the end. Dark, roasty and crunchy.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted cashews, toasted and roughly chopped

steps.title: Make a smooth base
steps.text: Whisk the yolks, sugar, cocoa and espresso powder in the saucepan, then add the cream a spoonful at a time until smooth before whisking in the milk. Adding liquid slowly stops the cocoa clumping.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir over low heat, scraping the base, for 8-10 min until it coats the spatula and reads 77-80 °C. The cocoa can catch, so keep the heat low and the spatula moving.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Mix in the salt, strain, and cool the custard over iced water before chilling it for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Toast the cashews
steps.text: Shake the cashews in the small dry frying pan over medium heat for 4-5 min until golden, then cool and chop. Toasting adds a deeper, buttery flavour and keeps them crunchy in the ice cream.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until thick, adding the cashews in the last minute so they are evenly spread.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 4 h until firm.

tips: Use unsalted cashews so the salt stays under control.
A common mistake is swapping in brewed coffee, which adds water and makes the ice cream icy. Espresso powder gives flavour without liquid.
Decaffeinated espresso powder works just as well.
storage: Freeze, covered, for up to 2 weeks; the cashews soften slightly after a week.
